resume: MONK-1 turns the FM-1 into the MonkSynth formant vocal synth: twelve singers, each with its own voice, whose mouth follows the vowel. Velocity sets the level, aftertouch moves the vowel.

commandes.role: Envelope page: Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release.
Choir page: Voices, Detune, Spread, Level.
Touch page: Pressure, Depth, Sensitive, Velocity.
Sing page: Vowel, Head, Breath, Glide.
Saves immediately (otherwise, it autosaves a few seconds later). Held 1.5 s, restores that singer's original voice.
HOLD: the note stays after release, another key takes over.
Selects the singer: Jerry the monk, Guppo, Philip, Suze, Gerald, Bess, EeOo, Snider, Fipsy, Peppo, Marley, Razor.
Changes the vowel, on any page.

gestes: SAVE held 1.5 s: the displayed singer gets its original voice back.
a_savoir: Single voice: the most recently held key sounds; when released, the previous one resumes, and moving from one to another glides (GLIDE).
